summary: The FRBPA_2026 entry faithfully reproduces the 95% credible upper limit (FRBPA Full, Fig. 3 upper panel) on g_aγγ from arXiv 2609.24085. Correct particle/coupling/axes, supported 95% confidence, genuine new exclusion (first FRBPA result, not a projection), representative points agree with the figure and abstract values, and the highlighted plots correctly accent the new region.

verdict.summary: The FRBPA_2026 entry faithfully reproduces the 95% credible upper limit (FRBPA Full, Fig. 3 upper panel) on g_aγγ from arXiv 2609.24085. Correct particle/coupling/axes, supported 95% confidence, genuine new exclusion (first FRBPA result, not a projection), representative points agree with the figure and abstract values, and the highlighted plots correctly accent the new region.

result_identity.evidence: Paper (title p.1, Sec.4) constrains the axion-photon Chern-Simons coupling g_aγγ vs ALDM mass; extraction targets the 'FRBPA (Full)' thick red solid 95% upper-limit curve in the upper panel of Figure 3 (p.13). Coupling type AxionPhoton, g_aγγ[GeV^-1] vs m_a[eV], matching the compilation plot axes.

novelty.evidence: First presentation of an FRB Polarization Array constraint (Sec.4.2, p.12: 'present the constraints from an FRBPA for the first time'). Full-correlation joint analysis of three repeaters is distinct from the prior FRB 20220912A result (Wang et al. 2025, ref 106) shown separately in Fig. 3. is_projection=false; Fig. 3 is an exclusion, consistent with the proposal.

confidence_level.evidence: Abstract (p.1): '95% credible upper limits on the Chern-Simons coupling'; Fig. 3 caption (p.13): '95% upper limits'. Stated 0.95 is paper-supported, not a default/placeholder.

conventions.evidence: Units g_aγγ[GeV^-1], m_a[eV] match paper and plot. DM density: paper rho_0=0.4 GeV/cm³ (Eq.2.5, p.9), repo stores native and rescales by sqrt(0.4/0.45)=0.9428 in PlotFuncs (chi ∝ 1/sqrt(rho)); direction correct (higher rho -> lower g limit). Birefringence is topological so no polarization-fraction conversion needed (null is appropriate). Highlighted overlay uses the same method, not a raw-data bypass.

numerical_agreement.evidence: Low-mass point 10^-23 eV = 2.547e-13 ≈ 10^-12.59 vs abstract 10^-12.6 (<2%). Endpoint 10^-18 eV = 1.343e-8 = 10^-7.87 vs abstract 10^-7.9. Spike at 5.6e-19 eV (2.1e-8) matches the BF peak the paper flags at m_a=5.6×10^-19 eV and the jagged high-mass rise in Fig. 3. Mid points (10^-21:2.3e-11, 10^-20:5.7e-11) consistent with the Fig. 3 FRBPA curve shape.

highlight_target.evidence: Highlighted PNGs (AxionPhoton_Ultralight_highlighted.png and _with_Projections_highlighted.png) accent exactly one red region: the FRBPA limit starting at ~2.5e-13 at 10^-23 eV and rising to the top near ~2-3e-19 eV, matching the extracted curve. No unrelated limit is highlighted.

visibility.evidence: Mass range 10^-23 to 10^-18 eV and coupling range are fully on-screen; 'FRBPA' label present. In the full compilation the limit is weaker than existing bounds (Sec.4.2) so it is largely subsumed, but the highlighted views make the new region clearly interpretable.

findings.description: The repo density rescaling treats the whole limit as ∝1/sqrt(rho_0) (local Earth density), but the paper's signal (Eq.2.5, p.9) combines a local Earth term (rho_0=0.4) and comparable simulation-calibrated host source terms (Sec.3.4, p.10), so strictly only the Earth term scales with rho_0.
findings.evidence: PlotFuncs applies dat[:,1]*sqrt(0.4/0.45); paper Eq.2.5 and Sec.3.4 emphasize source and Earth contributions are comparable.
findings.requested_change: None required — the 0.4→0.45 correction is ~6%, below extraction scatter and consistent with the compilation's uniform normalization convention; noted for transparency.

findings.description: In the non-highlighted full compilation the small red 'FRBPA' label at ~10^-23 eV overlaps the PSR J1937-4715 region and is hard to read.
findings.evidence: AxionPhoton_Ultralight.png shows faint red 'FRBPA' text near 10^-23 eV amid blue PTA regions; clearly visible only in highlighted views.
findings.requested_change: Optional: adjust label position/size for legibility; not blocking since the limit is legitimately subsumed by stronger existing bounds.
